project_info.color_palette: vibrant red, orange-red, black, warm skin tones

main_subject.detail: A person wearing an oversized red hoodie and striking dark sunglasses, front-facing with a slightly elevated chin and a commanding neutral expression.

items: dominant centered bust-up framing at eye level
vibrant orange or monochromatic red backdrop
dark sunglasses reflect the studio source

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: powerful red-background bounce with a focused studio key
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: dramatic warm reflections on sunglasses and defined illumination over face and torso

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with a portrait lens, high-detail studio photograph
technical_specs.color_treatment: high saturation and contrast, realistic fabric and skin texture

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Bold presence studio portrait of a person wearing an oversized red hoodie and striking dark sunglasses against a vibrant orange or monochromatic red background. Use bust-up framing, a front-facing posture, and a slightly elevated chin, captured at eye level with a full-frame camera and portrait lens. Use powerful studio lighting bouncing strongly from the intense background onto the face and torso, creating dramatic reflections on the sunglasses. Keep high saturation and contrast, a dominant centered composition, realistic fabric and skin texture, and commanding visual impact.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated skin, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. Optional person, wardrobe, sunglasses, and lighting references may be attached; preserve hoodie color and oversize fit, dark sunglasses, centered bust-up framing, red backdrop, and reflected studio source. The subject identity may be replaced.
